meta.title: Prompt enhance
meta.description: Adds an enhance button to the right of the composer. Clicking it first shows a one-line confirm above the button, "Inject AGENTS.md? Yes / No": Yes also sends AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md project rules, No uses the last two conversation rounds only. It then rewrites the draft into a directly executable prompt with the session's current model and puts the result back into the draft. The button needs a selected model and is disabled while the draft is empty; the write-back replaces the whole draft, including any reference chips in it.
